import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r8 import CAPTIONS
rc = R24.rc
r26 = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(r26.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('5683ff7b')
SRC = dict(r26=r26, r27=open(_p.__file__).read())
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('rev27r_'+n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = dict((n, mk(n)) for n in SRC)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
def run(pages, people, allowed):
    pdf = rc.pages_pdf(pages); out = ''
    for n, m in M.items():
        mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
        out += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
    return out
F = 'This Agreement is entered into between Fleet Test Co. ("Discloser") and '
REC = dict(
  hla=[F + 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Recipient").'],
  spell_hl=[F + 'HL Analytics, Inc. ("Recipient").'],
  spell_lite=[F + 'Harbor Lite Analytics LLC ("Recipient").'],
  spell_noinc=[F + 'Harbor Light Analytics ("Recipient").'],
  two_hlg_guarantor=[F + 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Recipient").', 'Harbor Light Group, Inc. ("Guarantor") joins this Agreement.'],
  two_hlg_recipient=[F + 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Recipient").', 'The parties agree with Harbor Light Group, Inc. ("Recipient").'],
  two_hlg_affiliate=[F + 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Recipient"). Harbor Light Group, Inc. ("Affiliate") is the parent of Recipient.'],
  two_spell_first=[F + 'HL Analytics, Inc. ("Recipient").', 'The parties agree with Harbor Light Analytics, Inc. ("Recipient").'],
)
for k in ('three_quoted', 'signature_same', 'signature_hla', 'signature_nw', 'conflict_hla_nw'):
    REC[k] = R24.cases.RECITALS[k]
def recital_rows(texts): return [(80 + 30 * i, t, False, 40) for i, t in enumerate(texts)]
sub = lambda rows, old, new: [(r[0], new, False, r[3]) if r[1] == old else r for r in rows]
def own_named(h, co, second):
    rows = [r for r in R24.company_block(h, co, 320, 300) if r[1] not in ('Name:', 'Title:')]
    return rows + [(312, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, 320), (324, second, False, 320)]
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); t = time.time()
AL = dict([(rc.PE, (2, 320, 300, 500)), (rc.DE, (2, 40, 300, 220))])
X = 72
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for rk, onsig, signer in product(REC, (False, True), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both')):
        def pages_for(sigrows):
            if onsig: return [[(80, 'Cover page', False, 40)], [r for r in recital_rows(REC[rk]) if True] + [(r[0] + 60, *r[1:]) for r in sigrows]]
            return [recital_rows(REC[rk]), sigrows]
        def al(a):
            if not onsig: return a
            return dict((k, (v[0], v[1], v[2] + 60, v[3])) for k, v in a.items())
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        aff = R24.company_block(None, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', 40, 500)
        fleet = R24.company_block('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 40)
        # A: own named block vetoed by Address
        for h, co in (('RECIPIENT:', 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.'), (None, 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.'), ('RECIPIENT:', None), ('THE SUPPLIER', None), ('RECIPIENT:', R24.HLA)):
            k = run(pages_for(fleet + own_named(h, co, 'Address: 100 Harbor Way') + aff), people, al(AL)); G[('A', k)] += 1
            if 'W' in k: EX[('A', k, rk, onsig, signer)] += 1
        # B: shared name
        if signer != 'both':
            fpat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.DE, company='Fleet Test Co.', side='us')
            for h, co in (('RECIPIENT:', 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.'), ('THE SUPPLIER', None), (None, None)):
                k = run(pages_for(sub(fleet, 'Name:', 'Name: Pat Smith') + R24.company_block(h, co, 320) + aff), [fpat, pat], al(AL)); G[('B', k)] += 1
                if 'W' in k: EX[('B', k, rk, onsig, signer)] += 1
        # E: L-2 stack + affiliate / own company line (L-2)
        for head, cap, line in product(('RECIPIENT:', None, 'For and on behalf of the Recipient'), CAPTIONS + ['By:'], ('HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.')):
            rows = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (310, 'By:', True, X)]
            if head: rows.append((340, head, False, X))
            rows += [(370, cap, True, X), (382, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, X), (420, 'Date:', True, X), (520, line, False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
            kind = 'E aff' if 'GROUP' in line else 'E L-2 own line'
            k = run(pages_for(rows), people, al(dict([(rc.PE, (2, 0, 370, 612)), (rc.DE, (2, 0, 270, 612))])))
            G[(kind, k)] += 1
            if 'W' in k and kind == 'E aff': EX[('E', k, rk, onsig, signer)] += 1
            if kind != 'E aff': EX[('L2', k, rk, onsig, signer)] += 1
print('http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for x in sorted(EX.items(), key=str):
    if x[0][0] != 'L2': print(' W', x)
L2 = Counter((k[1], k[2]) for k in EX.elements() if k[0] == 'L2'); print('L2', sorted(L2.items(), key=str))
